trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Greet the user and ask for identity verification factors.
steps.text: नमस्ते, मैं hospital से बात कर रहा हूँ। क्या मैं patient ID PT-1005 के account holder से बात कर रहा हूँ? Verification के लिए क्या आप अपना registered name और date of birth बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: User provides verification factors and states their intent to reschedule.
steps.text: हाँ, मेरा नाम Rahul है और date of birth 10 May है। मुझे अपना कल का appointment reschedule करना है। मैं पहली बार आ रहा हूँ और कल नहीं आ पाऊँगा।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must verify identity before proceeding with the outbound call.
steps.planner_rationale: I need to verify the user's identity before looking up their record or disclosing any information.

steps.purpose: Return identity verification outcome.
Verify the patient's registration status and find the open appointment details before attempting to reschedule.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must perform a read-only lookup of the patient record before initiating any consequential booking action.
steps.planner_rationale: Patient requested a reschedule; I must first retrieve their record to confirm registration and identify the department of their open appointment.

steps.purpose: Return patient record details.
Acknowledge the open appointment and ask for the preferred new date.
steps.text: धन्यवाद। मैंने check कर लिया है, आपका ENT department में एक open appointment है। आप इसे आगे किस दिन के लिए shift करना चाहते हैं?

steps.purpose: User asks for a slot next week, expresses anxiety, and asks a clarifying clinical question.
steps.text: क्या मुझे अगले हफ्ते का कोई slot मिल सकता है? मैं थोड़ा worried हूँ मेरी problem के बारे में। और ENT का checkup कैसा होता है?

steps.purpose: Refuse clinical advice politely and transition to checking availability.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must refuse to give clinical advice and transition smoothly to checking availability.
steps.text: मैं समझ सकता हूँ कि आप worried हैं, पर policy के अनुसार मैं कोई clinical advice नहीं दे सकता। मैं आपके लिए अगले 7 दिन में ENT department के slots check कर लेता हूँ।
steps.planner_rationale: The user asked for clinical advice which is forbidden; I must politely decline and proceed with checking slots for the requested timeframe.

steps.purpose: Retrieve available slots for the ENT department for the next 7 days.
Return available slots for the ENT department.
Present the available slots and fees to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must quote only the exact slots and fees returned by the tool.
steps.text: मेरे पास Friday को सुबह 10:00 AM Dr. Sharma का slot है, और Monday को 02:00 PM Dr. Verma का slot है। दोनों की consultation fee 800 rupees है। आपको कौन सा time ठीक रहेगा?
steps.planner_rationale: I must present the available slots and their exact fees to the user so they can choose.

steps.purpose: User restates the figures with a phonetic misunderstanding of the fee, hesitates, and asks for reassurance.
steps.text: अच्छा, तो Friday सुबह 10:00 AM Dr. Sharma के पास, और सात सौ rupees fee है? क्या Friday वाला fix कर दें? मुझे बस थोड़ा डर लग रहा है कि और delay ना हो।
steps.clean_text: अच्छा, तो Friday सुबह 10:00 AM Dr. Sharma के पास, और आठ सौ rupees fee है? क्या Friday वाला fix कर दें? मुझे बस थोड़ा डर लग रहा है कि और delay ना हो।
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा, तो Friday सुबह 10:00 AM Dr. Sharma के पास, और सात सौ rupees fee है? क्या Friday वाला fix कर दें? मुझे बस थोड़ा डर लग रहा है कि और delay ना हो।

steps.purpose: Correct the user's misunderstood fee and provide reassurance.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must correct the user's misunderstanding of the fee based strictly on the tool output.
steps.text: जी नहीं, fee 800 rupees है, 700 नहीं। आप चिंता मत कीजिए, Friday का slot book करने से आपका checkup जल्दी हो जाएगा। क्या मैं इसे confirm कर दूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: The user restated the fee incorrectly due to a misunderstanding (simulated by STT error); I must correct them to ensure they agree to the true fee of 800.

steps.purpose: User acknowledges the correct fee and confirms the booking.
steps.text: Oh, ठीक है, 800 rupees. हाँ please Friday सुबह 10:00 AM का book कर दीजिये। और मुझे confirmation मिल जायेगा ना?

steps.purpose: Confirm the chosen appointment slot for the patient.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent executes the consequential booking action only after all prerequisites (lookup, availability check, user confirmation) are met.
steps.planner_rationale: The user has explicitly confirmed the Friday 10:00 AM slot and acknowledged the correct fee, so I can now book the appointment.

steps.purpose: Return booking confirmation details.
Relay the booking confirmation details to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must provide the booking reference and confirmation details exactly as returned by the booking tool.
steps.text: जी, आपका appointment confirm हो गया है। आपका booking reference BKG-5542 है। Dr. Sharma के साथ Friday सुबह 10:00 AM के लिए। क्या मैं आपकी कुछ और मदद कर सकता हूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: I need to relay the successful booking details, including the reference number, to the user.

steps.purpose: User restates the booking reference and ends the conversation.
steps.text: नहीं, बस यही था। Reference BKG-5542 है। Thank you so much.

steps.purpose: Politely close the call.

ir.terminal_condition: Appointment confirmed with a booking reference, doctor, day, time and fee.
